changed_steps.step: Delete the preview database branches of pull requests that are closed
Start what the owner's review of a pull request in conflict asks for

lesson.summary: The first scheduled flag-idle run after #679 did what the pull request claimed: the new missed-reviews step ran and found nothing to start, and the preview-database cleanup was skipped by its own condition because this repository sets no NEON_PROJECT_ID, so nothing needs doing.
lesson.detail: PR #679 added two steps to flag-idle.yml. The first, "Delete the preview database branches of pull requests that are closed", runs only when vars.NEON_PROJECT_ID is set. tinyfactory has no app and no Neon project, so the step was skipped as designed, and it can only be exercised in a project. The second, "Start what the owner's review of a pull request in conflict asks for", ran factory/scripts/missed-reviews.sh. It succeeded and logged "no factory pull request in conflict holds an owner's review that GitHub ran nothing for: nothing was started". The later flag-idle.sh step still ran. The run concluded success. Ryan's unverified assumptions on #679 are about ci.yml's drizzle migration check, not this workflow, so this run neither confirms nor refutes them.

cost.amount: Nothing: the run succeeded with no agent session, at $0 and 0 turns.

lesson.saves: Nothing: the run cost $0 and had no fault to prevent.
